hash_rule: File hashes use original raw bytes. Inherited research/ source excerpt hashes are retained exactly from ordinary002 and use raw selected lines with original line endings and keepends, including mixed LF/CRLF where present. Newly generated work/ proof and manuscript excerpts normalize CRLF to LF and join selected lines with no added final separator. Parsed-use hashes use JSON.stringify with preserved property order.

excerpt_conventions.inherited_research_locations: Original ordinary002 raw selected lines with keepends; no replacement or normalization of inherited hashes.
excerpt_conventions.new_work_locations: CRLF normalized to LF; selected lines joined with LF without an added final separator.
excerpt_conventions.use_hashes: JSON.stringify parsed record with preserved key order.
